title: The Developing Brain Under Different Influences

zones.label: Sleep
zones.summary: Sleep supports attention, learning, mood regulation, and physical recovery.
facts: Consistent timing can support the body clock.
Persistent sleep problems deserve adult or professional help.

zones.label: Exercise
zones.summary: Regular movement supports brain health, mood, sleep, and stress regulation.
facts: Different activities can provide different benefits.

zones.label: Alcohol
zones.summary: Alcohol can impair judgment, coordination, memory, and reaction time.
facts: A developing brain is still building decision and self-control systems.
Avoid riding with an impaired driver and seek help in emergencies.

zones.label: Nicotine
zones.summary: Nicotine is addictive and can affect attention, learning, mood, and impulse control.
facts: Commercial tobacco and vaping products can deliver nicotine.
Support is available for quitting; shame is not treatment.

zones.label: Cannabis
zones.summary: Cannabis can affect attention, memory, coordination, and judgment.
facts: Effects vary with potency, dose, route, person, and context.
Mixing substances increases uncertainty and risk.

zones.label: Medication Misuse
zones.summary: Using medication differently than directed or using someone else’s medicine can cause serious harm.
facts: Prescription use and misuse are not the same.
Ask a trusted adult, pharmacist, or clinician when unsure.
